  group_by: value_band is
      pick '1. under 5k'  when cust_value < 5000
      pick '2. 5k-15k'    when cust_value < 15000
      pick '3. 15k-30k'   when cust_value < 30000
      pick '4. 30k-60k'   when cust_value < 60000
      else '5. 60k+'
  aggregate:
    customers is count()
    pct_of_customers is count() / all(count())
    pct_of_value is cust_value.sum() / all(cust_value.sum())
    mean_value is cust_value.avg()
    mean_orders is cust_orders.avg()
    mean_tenure_days is avg(days(first_order::date to last_order::date))
  order_by: value_band
}
